definition.zh: 五项运营 KPI 的统一登记容器；当前没有真实观测基线或可信区间。
definition.en: Unified registry for five operational KPIs; no observed baseline or credible interval is available yet.

operational_kpi_registry.timepoint: baseline not established; first complete pilot-year ledger and annual review are the planned measurement point
operational_kpi_registry.sample: No observed sample. Planned census of all scheduled sessions, opted-in aggregate participants, submitted/opened scenarios, published outreach records, and inspection records for the pilot year.
operational_kpi_registry.source: Not collected in participant package; requires operator ledger, anonymized aggregate counts, publication log and professional inspection records.
operational_kpi_registry.formula: not applicable for aggregate container; calculate each child metric with its registered numerator and denominator
operational_kpi_registry.responsible_party: concept role: pilot operator; data-quality and public disclosure review by an independent professional/public review group
operational_kpi_registry.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; no numeric target or baseline is asserted.

definition.zh: 活动达成率：按计划完成且经人工复核的活动场次 ÷ 计划活动场次。
definition.en: Activity attainment: completed and human-verified sessions divided by scheduled sessions.

activity_attainment_rate.denominator: scheduled sessions in the approved annual calendar
activity_attainment_rate.timepoint: baseline not established; measured at each annual review after the pilot year
activity_attainment_rate.sample: census of the annual activity ledger; no observed sample in this package
activity_attainment_rate.source: operator activity ledger to be established; no participant measurement
activity_attainment_rate.responsible_party: pilot operator; annual review by professional/public review group
activity_attainment_rate.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; numeric baseline/range intentionally omitted.

definition.zh: 社区活跃度：测量期内参与至少一次循环活动的去重匿名参与单元 ÷ 受邀或服务覆盖的匿名参与单元。
definition.en: Community activity: unique anonymized participating units during the measurement period divided by invited or service-covered anonymized units.

community_activity.numerator: unique anonymized participating units with at least one recorded participation
community_activity.denominator: anonymized units invited or covered by the service during the same period
community_activity.timepoint: baseline not established; quarterly observation after privacy review and annual roll-up
community_activity.sample: No observed sample. Planned opt-in, anonymized aggregate counts only; no individual-identifying tracking.
community_activity.source: operator participation ledger and public-service coverage register to be established
community_activity.responsible_party: community/property coordination role; privacy and human review gate
community_activity.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; numeric baseline/range intentionally omitted.

definition.zh: 场景开放率：完成数据与隐私审查并进入公开试点的场景申请数 ÷ 有效提交的场景申请数。
definition.en: Scenario opening rate: scenario applications that pass data/privacy review and enter a public pilot divided by valid submitted applications.

scenario_opening_rate.numerator: applications passing review and entering a public pilot
scenario_opening_rate.denominator: valid scenario applications received in the measurement period
scenario_opening_rate.timepoint: baseline not established; reported per opening cycle and at annual review
scenario_opening_rate.sample: No observed application sample. Planned full ledger of valid applications with human review decisions.
scenario_opening_rate.source: scenario-opening application and review log to be established
scenario_opening_rate.responsible_party: scenario-opening review group; named scenario owner and human approval gate
scenario_opening_rate.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; numeric baseline/range intentionally omitted.

definition.zh: 传播触达转化率：完成明确后续行动（报名、到场、提交建议或申请试点）的匿名聚合触达单元 ÷ 可核验的匿名聚合触达单元。
definition.en: Reach-to-conversion: anonymized aggregate reached units completing a defined next action (registration, attendance, feedback or pilot application) divided by verifiable anonymized reached units.

reach_to_conversion_rate.numerator: anonymized aggregate reached units completing a defined next action
reach_to_conversion_rate.denominator: verifiable anonymized aggregate reached units for the same campaign and period
reach_to_conversion_rate.timepoint: baseline not established; measured per campaign after communication-channel logging is approved
reach_to_conversion_rate.sample: No observed sample. Planned channel-level aggregate logs; no cookies, face recognition or individual tracking.
reach_to_conversion_rate.source: campaign publication and action logs to be established; no participant baseline
reach_to_conversion_rate.responsible_party: communication lead; privacy reviewer and public disclosure reviewer
reach_to_conversion_rate.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; numeric baseline/range intentionally omitted.

definition.zh: 地标运营完好率：检查期内满足安全、卫生、可达、可用与公示要求的地标检查记录 ÷ 地标检查记录总数。
definition.en: Landmark operational integrity: inspection records meeting safety, hygiene, accessibility, usability and disclosure requirements divided by total landmark inspection records.

landmark_operational_integrity.numerator: inspection records passing the published checklist
landmark_operational_integrity.denominator: all scheduled landmark inspection records in the period
landmark_operational_integrity.timepoint: baseline not established; measured at every scheduled inspection and annual review
landmark_operational_integrity.sample: No observed inspection sample. Planned census of the three conceptual landmark nodes after a lawful pilot is approved.
landmark_operational_integrity.source: operator maintenance and inspection ledger to be established; professional acceptance remains required
landmark_operational_integrity.responsible_party: pilot operator and facilities/maintenance role; professional safety and accessibility review
landmark_operational_integrity.target_note: Unverified design-target illustration only; numeric baseline/range intentionally omitted.

operational_kpi_registry.reason: No real operating ledger or observed sample was supplied; baseline and interval remain unknown until a lawful pilot produces anonymized aggregate records.
